title: The Blood Moon Rises
summary: Beneath Velmoragh, something vast turns in its chains. Development build 0.1 opens the ruins to the first battles.
body: This is a development build of Bloodfall: War of the Ancients. The Velmoragh battlefield, creep waves, towers, neutral camps, bots and the first heroes are playable offline and on local dedicated servers. Vharoth's prison is sealed - for now.
author: Bloodfall Development

title: Development Build 0.1.0
summary: Authoritative dedicated servers, accounts, lobbies, matchmaking, and the first two heroes.
body:
- Velmoragh: three lanes, river, jungle camps, secret shops, Vharoth's pit
- Heroes: Vorak, the Blood Tyrant and Ilyra, the Blood Witch
- 38 items including recipes, consumables and wards
- Bots (Beginner to Nightmare)
- Accounts, friends, parties, chat, clans, custom games, server browser, matchmaking
- Match history, ratings and leaderboards
author: Bloodfall Development

title: Hero Spotlight: Vorak, the Blood Tyrant
summary: An ancient warlord who charges into the fray and ends fights with a crimson meteor of his own making.
body: Crimson Charge breaks the first hero it meets. Blood Rend bleeds everything around him. Every fourth blow of Sovereign's Wrath crushes. And when Vorak leaps into the sky, Bloodfall answers.
author: Bloodfall Development

title: Hero Spotlight: Ilyra, the Blood Witch
summary: She pays for her spells in blood - and collects the debt from you.
body: Ilyra's basic spells cost health instead of mana. Blood Lance pierces a line of enemies, Hemorrhage Field erupts after a short delay, and Exsanguinate drains a single victim until their blood boils.
author: Bloodfall Development

title: Running your own local servers
summary: Development builds connect to services on this machine. Start the backend and a game server with Tools/dev/run-local.
body: See SERVER_DEPLOYMENT.md for the ports and configuration used by the local service stack.
author: Bloodfall Development
